references.text: This is the direct fulfillment of the oath regarding burial in Canaan that was made earlier.
Contrasting portraits of Pharaoh: he hinders God's will in Exodus, but respects the patriarchs' oath in Genesis.
A clear theological contrast: The old oath (Genesis) that hinders a calling in Luke shows the development of discipleship requirements.
Direct fulfillment of Jacob's specific burial instruction given in this verse.
Thematic parallel: The need to secure burial in Canaan as confirmation of God's promise of the land.
